senses.gloss:
पङ्क पङ्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. 1. पच् or पञ्च्), mud, mire, dirt, clay; a slough, a
quagmire; ointment, unguent; moral impurity, sin;
[cf. निष्-पङ्क, नील-प्˚.]
—पङ्क-कर्वट, अस्,
m. soft mud, especially such as is left by the retiring
of floods or on the banks of a river, alluvium, a marsh,
a quagmire.
—पङ्क-कीर, अस्, m. an aquatic bird, a
lap-wing.
—पङ्क-क्रीड, अस्, आ, अम्, wallowing or
sporting in mud; (अस्), m. a pig; (also पङ्क-
क्रीडनक, अस्, m.)
—पङ्क-गडक, अस्, m. or
पङ्क-गति, इस्, f. a small fish, Macrognathus Pan-
calus.
—पङ्क-ग्राह, अस्, m. the marine monster
Makara, q. v.
—पङ्क-च्छिद्, त्, m. ‘mud-destroyer,’
Strychnos Potatorum (the fruit of which is used for
purifying foul water).
—पङ्क-ज, अम्, n. ‘mud-
born,’ a species of lotus, Nelumbium Speciosum (or
rather its flower which closes in the evening); (अस्),
m. an epithet of Brahmā, (incorrect for पङ्कज-
ज, ‘lotus-born’); (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.
—पङ्कज-जन्मन्, आ, m. ‘sprung from a lotus,’
an epithet of Brahmā.
—पङ्कज-नाभ, अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘having a lotus springing from his navel,’ an
epithet of Viṣṇu.
—पङ्क-जन्मन्, अ, n. = पङ्क-
ज.
—पङ्कज-पत्त्र, अम्, n. the leaf of a lotus.
—पङ्कजपत्त्र-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having
eyes like lotus-leaves.
—पङ्कजावली (˚ज-आव्˚), f. a
particular metre; [cf. पङ्कावली.]
—पङ्क-जित्, त्,
[]
m., N. of a son of Garuḍa.
—पङ्कजिनी, f. (fr.
पङ्कजिन् which is fr. पङ्क-ज), Nelumbium Spe-
ciosum (the plant itself), a group of such lotuses, a
lotus pool, a pool or pond where the lotus grows or
a place abounding with that flower; the flexible
stalk of a water-lily.
—पङ्क-ता, f. the nature or
property of mud, muddiness.
—पङ्क-दिग्ध, अस्,
आ, अम्, besmeared with mud, soiled with dirt.
—पङ्कदिग्ध-शरीर, अस्, m. ‘having a mud-
smeared body,’ N. of a Dānava; (also read as if two
names, पङ्क-दिग्ध and शरीर.)
—पङ्कदिग्-
धाङ्ग (˚ध-अङ्˚), अस्, m. ‘having mud-smeared
limbs,’ N. of a being attending on Skanda.
—पङ्क-
प्रभा, f. (with Jainas) N. of one of the seven
divisions of hell (where mud or mire takes the place
of light).
—पङ्क-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, sunk in the mire.
—पङ्क-भारक, अस्, आ, अम्, laden with mud,
muddy.
—पङ्क-मज्जन, अम्, n. immersion in
mud.
—पङ्क-मण्डूक, अस्, m. a bivalve conch;
(also wrongly read -मण्डूक.)
—पङ्क-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, full of mud or mire, muddy.
—पङ्क-रुह्,
ट्, or पङ्क-रुह, अम्, n. ‘mud-growing,’ a lotus.
—पङ्क-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, muddy, covered with
mud.
—पङ्क-वास, अस्, m. ‘dwelling in mud,’
a crab.
—पङ्क-शुक्ति, इस्, f. ‘mud-shell,’ a par-
ticular species of muscle or cockle (the stair-case
shell, spinnet shell).
—पङ्क-सूरण, अस्, m. ‘mud-
root,’ the fibrous edible root of a lotus; (also written
पङ्क-शूरण, पङ्क-षूरण.)
—पङ्के-ज,
अम्, n. ‘born in the mud,’ a lotus.
—पङ्के-रुह,
अम्, n. ‘growing in mud,’ a lotus; (अस्), m. the
Indian crane (as a synonym of पुष्कर).
—पङ्के-
शय, अस्, आ, अम्, resting or dwelling in mud.

पङ्कार, अस्, m. the aquatic plant Blyxa Oc-
tandra or Vallisneria (= शैवल); the aquatic plant
Trapa Bispinosa (= जल-कुब्जक); a dam, dike,
or raised bank forming a path amidst inundated fields;
stairs, steps, a ladder.

पङ्कावली, f. = पङ्कजावली (of which it may
be a contraction).

पङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.), muddy,
filled or covered with mud; [cf. मल-प्˚.]

पङ्किल, अस्, आ, अम्, muddy, dirty, clayey; (अस्),
m. a boat, canoe.

पङ्कण पङ्कण, wrong form for पक्कण,
q. v.

पङ्क्ति पङ्क्ति, इस्, ई, f. (connected with पञ्-
चन्), a row or line or set of five, a collection of
five, the number five; a sort of fivefold metre con-
sisting of five Pādas of eight syllables each; (in the
later literature) any stanza of four times ten syllables
(or of four lines, each line consisting of ten syllables);
the number ten, (sometimes in comp., cf. रावण-
शिरः-प्˚, पङ्क्ति-ग्रीव, पङ्क्ति-रथ); a line,
range, row, series; a group, flock, troop; a heap;
a row of people sitting down to a meal, a company,
society, assembly, party; a company of persons of
the same caste; the living generation; the earth;
cooking, maturing, (incorrectly for पक्ति); fame,
celebrity (for पक्ति); [cf. अक्षर-प्˚, आस्तार-प्˚,
पद-प्˚, प्रस्तार-प्˚.]
—पङ्क्ति-कण्टक, ‘having
rows of thorns (?),’ a white-flowering Achyranthes.
—पङ्क्ति-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘ten-necked,’ an epithet of
Rāvaṇa; [cf. पङ्क्ति-रथ.]
—पङ्क्ति-चर, अस्,
m. ‘going in lines,’ an osprey.
—पङ्क्ति-दूष or
-दूषक, अस्, आ, अम्, defiling or contaminating any
society or company of persons; (अस्), m. an improper
person with whom to associate, (opposed to पङ्क्ति-
पावन.)
—पङ्क्ति-दोष, अस्, m. a bane of society,
anything which defiles or contaminates a company,
what spoils a society.
—पङ्क्ति-पावन, अस्, आ, अम्,
purifying a society or company of persons, (opposed
to पङ्क्ति-दूष); (अस्), m. a respectable or emi-
nent person.
—पङ्क्ति-रथ, अस्, m. ‘having ten
chariots,’ a N. of Daśa-ratha, the father of Rāma-
candra.
—पङ्क्ति-राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. (a sacri-
fice) containing fivefold gifts; (Sāy.) abounding in
properly presented oblations.
—पङ्क्ति-वीज, अस्, m.
[]
a species of plant (= वर्वूर).
—पङ्क्ती-कृत,
अस्, आ, अम्, associated in groups.
—पङ्क्त्य्-उत्तर,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a Paṅkti at the end.

पङ्क्तिका, f. a row, line, (in अक्षर-पङ्क्तिका,
a row of letters.)

पङ्गु पङ्गु, उस्, ऊस् or वी, उ (perhaps fr.
अप-अङ्ग, said to be connected with rt. 1. खञ्ज्),
lame, crippled, halt, one who has lost his legs, &c.;
(उस्), m. the planet Saturn (as moving slowly); an
epithet of Nirjita-varman.
—पङ्गु-ग्राह, अस्, m.
the sea-monster Makara, q. v. [cf. पङ्क-ग्राह, अस्,]; one
of the signs of the zodiac, see मकर.
—पङ्गु-
ता, f. or पङ्गु-त्व, अम्, n. lameness, deformity,
mutilation.
—पङ्गुत्व-हारिणी, f. a species of shrub
(= शिमृडी).
पङ्गुक, अस्, आ, अम्, = पङ्गु, lame.

पङ्गुल, अस्, आ, अम्, lame, crippled; (अस्), m. a
horse of a glassy or silvery white colour; (अम्?),
n. lameness (?).

पाङ्क्त पाङ्क्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पङ्क्ति), con-
sisting of five parts, fivefold (Ved.); relating to or
composed in the Paṅkti metre; an epithet of a kind
of Soma; (अम्), n., scil. सामन्, N. of a Sāman.
—पाङ्क्त-ता, f. or पाङ्क्त-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. five-
foldness, fivefold nature or condition.

पाङ्क्तकाकुभ, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. पङ्क्ति-ककुभ्),
Ved. an epithet of a Pra-gātha consisting of the Paṅkti
and Kakubh metres.

पाङ्क्तेय or पाङ्क्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit to sit in
the general row at meals, fit to be associated with,
admissible into society, fit for respectable society.

पाङ्क्त्र पाङ्क्त्र, अस्, m., Ved. (according to
Mahī-dhara) a kind of mouse.

पाङ्गुल्य पाङ्गुल्य, अम्, n. (fr. पङ्गुल),
limping, halting, hobbling.

पङ्कय, Nom. P. पङ्कयति, -यितुम्, to make
muddy, bemire.
